name: stale_aggregate
description: In the POST /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber/ship handler, the code updates lineitem.l_shipdate but does not update the parent orders.o_latest_shipdate summary field. In the GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey handler, it reads and returns orders.o_latest_shipdate directly without recalculating it from current lineitem rows, so the parent aggregate can become stale after the write.
